errors.text_span: For the “Prefix” method, the “base” bar reaches approximately 85.3, whereas the “large” bar reaches approximately 87.3
errors.evidence: For the 'Prefix' method, both the 'base' and 'large' bars are visibly below the 86 GLUE Performance line. The description incorrectly states their values as 85.3 and 87.3. The 'large' bar's value is particularly inaccurate; it is at approximately 85.6, but is reported as 87.3, which is on the other side of the 86 and 87 performance levels.

errors.evidence: For the 'S₅-model' method, the 'base' bar is visibly above the midpoint between 86 and 88 (i.e., > 87), at approximately 87.2, not 86.7. The 'large' bar is the highest on the chart, at approximately 89.1, not 88.7.
